pana: adhyātman arūpasaṃjñī bahirdhā rūpāṇi paśyati lohitāni lohitavarṇāni lohitanidarśanāni lohita nirbhāsāni tadyathā bandhujīvakapuṣpaṃ saṃpannaṃ vā vārāṇaseyaṃ vastraṃ lohitaṃ lohitavarṇaṃ lohitanidarśanaṃ lohitanirbhāsaṃ evamevādhyātmam arūpasaṃjñī bahirdhā rūpāṇi paśyati lohitāni lohitavarṇāni lohitanidarśanāni lohitavarṇāni lohitanidarśanāni lohitanirbhāsāni idaṃ pañcamam abhibhvāyatanam
कर्मणि च येन संस्पर्शात् कर्तुः शरीरसुखम्
pani॑yase: उषो न शुभ्र आ भरा पनीयसे
panamva: adhyātman arūpasaṃjñī bahirdhā rūpāṇi paśyati pītāni pītavarṇāni pītanidarśanāni pītanirbhāsāni tadyathā karṇikārapuṣpaṃ saṃpannam vā vārāṇaseyaṃ vastraṃ pītaṃ pītavarṇaṃ pītanidarśanaṃ pītanirbhāsam evam evādhyātmam arūpasaṃjñī bahirdhā rūpāṇi paśyati pīta varṇāni pītanidarśanāni pītanirbhāsāni idaṃ caturtham abhibhvāyanam
